treatments.disclaimerBody:
GlowLog helps you remember and log your doses. It doesn't give medical advice: always follow your doctor's instructions on dose and timing. Warnings about product combinations are general and may not fit your situation.

Treatment data stays on this device and is included in backups you export.
treatments.noDosesOnDay: No doses were scheduled on this day
treatments.conflict_isotretinoin: Isotretinoin already dries out and sensitizes skin, and {{actives}} usually makes that worse. Ask your doctor before using this product.
treatments.conflict_tretinoin: Using {{actives}} alongside tretinoin can over-irritate skin, and benzoyl peroxide can make tretinoin less effective. Check with your doctor.
treatments.conflict_adapalene: Combining {{actives}} with adapalene can over-irritate skin. Check with your doctor.
treatments.sunTip: {{name}} can make skin more sensitive to the sun. Don't skip sunscreen.
treatments.conflictDisclaimer: General guidance only, not medical advice.
treatments.notificationsDeniedDesc: Allow GlowLog notifications in Settings to get dose reminders. The treatment was saved either way.
